items: The contract is signed outside VIC, on paper or electronically.
You upload it here as a PDF, with its number and period.
The volunteer sees it right away in the app, under Documents.
Certificates are generated in VIC from the approved hours, signed and uploaded the same way.

status.title: Statuses
